summary.text: Gabby Salinas is a Democratic state representative from Memphis representing Tennessee House District 96 (part of Shelby County), a member of the 114th General Assembly. She is a pharmaceutical scientist and a former chair of the Shelby County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Salinas holds a diploma from St. Agnes Academy, a B.S. in biochemistry from Christian Brothers University and an M.S. in pharmaceutical sciences from the University of Kentucky College of Pharmacy.
Her page lists membership in the Tennessee Progressive Caucus and recognition in the Memphis Business Journal's Top 40 Under 40.
